It was established in 1958. On January 1, 1969, the college was included under Section 2(F) of the U.G.C. Act, 1956, and on June 17, 1972, the college was included by the U.G.C. under Section 12(B) of the U.G.C. Act, 1956. Due to an overwhelming response from the student community and a rapid increase in the number of students admitted in various faculties, the college was upgraded to a Post Graduate College from May 1, 1973. It was declared as the lead college of the Neemuch district in 1999. Government Post Graduate College, Neemuch, is a government institution affiliated to Vikram University, Ujjain, which was once the seat of Vikramaditya and produced the Shakespeare of India, Kalidas. Currently, the college provides education in all three faculties – Science, Arts and Commerce. It runs Post Graduate Programmes in 12 subjects. Due to rapid changes caused by globalisation, privatisation, and the growth of information technology, so many changes have taken place in the sphere of education throughout the world. The college administration has always taken these changes into account and has launched self-finance professional programs like B.Com. in Computer Application, B.A. in Computer Application, B.Sc. in Computer Science, B.B.A., B.C.A. and M.Sc.in Computer Science and MSW to help poor students. The college is situated on Manasa Road at a distance of three kilometres from the town in a naturally beautiful spot and has a widely spread campus, which has playgrounds and all the other facilities. It has a large campus spreading on 32.44 acres (13128.02 sq. Mts). To create good academic environment, the college provides a clean and beautiful campus. The college has good infrastructural facilities to support teaching and learning. During the last four years new Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology labs, and 10 spacious Classrooms have been constructed. The college presently has 39 (27+12 Departmental) spacious and ventilated rooms, 5 well-equipped laboratories with separate buildings and a rich, fully computerised library. The college has a well-developed sports complex that provides facilities for the following games – Football, Cricket, Basketball, Volleyball, Kabbadi, Kho-kho, Athletics and Lawn Tennis. The entire college, including the administrative office, library, laboratories and all the departments, has been fully automated. The college has a rich library with more than 75,600 books. In addition to various textbooks, the collection of books in the library includes 15,000 reference books, including various encyclopedias, dictionaries, yearbooks and biographies etc. The library also subscribes 15 Journals, 35 periodicals and 20 dailies to provide the latest information about research and developments and events of national and international importance. The college has well-qualified staff and is a recognised research centre of Commerce. All the P.G. departments have ICT-enabled classrooms. The academic, administrative and finance sections of the college are fully computerised. Through NCC, NSS and YRC, students are provided sufficient opportunities to participate in community services to ensure the all-around growth of the students. The college moulds the personalities of the students to prepare them for their future lives as well as livelihoods. It was established in 1958. On January 1, 1969, the college was included under Section 2(F) of the U.G.C. Act, 1956, and on June 17, 1972, the college was included by the U.G.C. under Section 12(B) of the U.G.C. Act, 1956. Due to an overwhelming response from the student community and a rapid increase in the number of students admitted in various faculties, the college was upgraded to a Post Graduate College from May 1, 1973. It was declared as the lead college of the Neemuch district in 1999. Government Post Graduate College, Neemuch, is a government institution affiliated to Vikram University, Ujjain, which was once the seat of Vikramaditya and produced the Shakespeare of India, Kalidas. Currently, the college provides education in all three faculties – Science, Arts and Commerce. It runs Post Graduate Programmes in 12 subjects. Due to rapid changes caused by globalisation, privatisation, and the growth of information technology, so many changes have taken place in the sphere of education throughout the world. The college administration has always taken these changes into account and has launched self-finance professional programs like B.Com. in Computer Application, B.A. in Computer Application, B.Sc. in Computer Science, B.B.A., B.C.A. and M.Sc.in Computer Science and MSW to help poor students. The college is situated on Manasa Road at a distance of three kilometres from the town in a naturally beautiful spot and has a widely spread campus, which has playgrounds and all the other facilities. It has a large campus spreading on 32.44 acres (13128.02 sq. Mts). To create good academic environment, the college provides a clean and beautiful campus. The college has good infrastructural facilities to support teaching and learning. During the last four years new Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology labs, and 10 spacious Classrooms have been constructed. The college presently has 39 (27+12 Departmental) spacious and ventilated rooms, 5 well-equipped laboratories with separate buildings and a rich, fully computerised library. The college has a well-developed sports complex that provides facilities for the following games – Football, Cricket, Basketball, Volleyball, Kabbadi, Kho-kho, Athletics and Lawn Tennis. The entire college, including the administrative office, library, laboratories and all the departments, has been fully automated. The college has a rich library with more than 75,600 books. In addition to various textbooks, the collection of books in the library includes 15,000 reference books, including various encyclopedias, dictionaries, yearbooks and biographies etc. The library also subscribes 15 Journals, 35 periodicals and 20 dailies to provide the latest information about research and developments and events of national and international importance. The college has well-qualified staff and is a recognised research centre of Commerce. All the P.G. departments have ICT-enabled classrooms. The academic, administrative and finance sections of the college are fully computerised. Through NCC, NSS and YRC, students are provided sufficient opportunities to participate in community services to ensure the all-around growth of the students. The college moulds the personalities of the students to prepare them for their future lives as well as livelihoods.
